description: Weather timeline for the Example District flood scenario. Ordered by timestamp so the sequence itself is the test fixture for TC-07: conditions worsen, and incidents must be reassessed as a result.
provenance_note: These are RECORDS of what a weather integration returned. Where the integration is unconfigured the system runs in documented simulation mode and labels every output simulation_mode. Do not present these rows as live observations.

timeline.note: Advisory raised. Correlates with SRC-007 gauge reading.
Escalates advisory -> warning. INC-003 severity must rise on this data.
Severe warning. This is the escalation trigger for TC-07: flood incidents must be reassessed, not left at their morning banding.
Downgraded from severe. Improvement must not silently erase the recorded reassessment.
Drives INC-005 wildfire escalation potential. Wind, not rain, is the risk driver.

scenario_notes: Warning levels escalate advisory -> warning -> severe_warning across the morning.
Rainfall accumulates monotonically; it never resets between rows.
INC-005 wildfire is driven by WIND, not rainfall. A rain-only rule would miss it entirely.
